sources_read.section: types, tables, helper functions, RLS enable + every policy, seed

scope: Copy 0001-0003 unchanged into database-thinkboard-lite/supabase/migrations/, author 0004_lite.sql from 02 §8.1 plus the additions the 0001 read made necessary, prove it resets twice and re-applies as a no-op, and repoint doc references to database-thinkboard-lite/. Out of scope: seed data and types (003), RLS behaviour tests (002), the live topic (015), any table, column or policy not in 02 §8.1 or recorded below.

acceptance_criteria.text: 0001-0003 apply with no manual fix; the §11 verify row is answered from the files: helpers are STABLE (pass), RLS is on for the run cluster (pass), 0001 DOES grant member writes on the run cluster (fail -> handled in g5), memory_entries has no write policy (-> DB-Q10, see open questions), 0003 sets default privileges (DB-F10 grant is redundant but harmless).
0004_lite.sql contains db §8.1 verbatim, or every difference is listed in code.json.decisions; note_input_mode has three values only after C6 is signed off.
highlights, highlight_notes, mini_conclusions and pipeline_runs each carry an after-row broadcast trigger with the NULL-topic guard; highlight and note triggers send RETRACT on unshare.
Both realtime.messages policies exist and re-create cleanly on re-run.

The two Full policies are dropped and replaced; client with-checks test membership; run-cluster reads are private and writes are owner-or-leader — including restrictive insert/update/delete on pipeline_stages, points, point_conclusions, run_renderings and a restrictive delete on pipeline_runs, because 0001's 'session runs' and 'run *' policies grant every member for-all.
supabase db reset exits 0 twice in a row; applying 0004 a second time on the same database exits 0.
Either create_workspace exists with a human-confirmed signature, or g7 is blocked with that reason.

open_questions: C6 — AWAITING HUMAN SIGN-OFF: note_input_mode ('keyboard','ink','stylus_os') + transcribed_by. g2 does not ship until answered.

DB-Q6 (defaulted: create_workspace security-definer RPC; creator is leader) — CONFIRM SIGNATURE. 0001 makes teams and team_members select-only for clients, so the RPC is required, not optional. Proposed: create_workspace(p_name text, p_title text, p_goal text) returns uuid (the session id), creating team, leader row, board, column, session in one transaction. g7 blocked until confirmed.

NEW (from the 0001 read) — leadership transfer (task 008 g3, D-09) also needs a definer RPC, for the same reason as DB-Q6: team_members has no client write policy. Proposed: transfer_leadership(p_team uuid, p_to_profile uuid), callable by the current leader. Raise now; build with DB-Q6.

DB-Q10 (defaulted: add a restrictive policy if members can write group scope) — the real finding is the opposite: memory_entries has only a SELECT policy in 0001, so nobody can write the leader's notulen (task 013 g2) or the workspace's initial ideas. Proposed permissive write policy: (scope = 'group' and is_team_leader(team_id)) or (scope = 'initial' and can_lead_session(session_id)). Needs a yes before it is added.
D-01 (defaulted: individual is a privacy boundary) — the private-highlight policies exist because of it.
D-05 (confirmed: 06-whole-apps-task.md is the backlog) — this is task 001 of it.
D-07 (defaulted: explicit promotion via shared_at) — promote_highlight() is the promotion path.
D-12 (unanswered) — listed per spec §10; no effect on the SQL.
DB-Q4 (defaulted: keep parked tables parked) — nothing dropped.
Location: the owner named database-thinkboard-lite/ as the Supabase folder (P0). Docs still say thinkboard-supabase/; they are repointed in this task.
risks: The RLS rewrite is the highest-risk item in the plan (spec §11 #3); task 002 is its proof.

Restrictive policies AND with 0001's permissive ones: a restrictive policy with no permissive grant denies everything. Every restrictive write added in g5 sits on a table where 0001 (or §8.1) already grants.
supabase db reset needs the local Docker stack. The supabase images are already present; if CLI 2.117 wants different tags it will pull them, which is a download to confirm first.
Migration names: 0001_initial.sql etc. are kept; the CLI orders by the numeric prefix, so 0004_lite.sql sorts last.
Security-definer functions must pin search_path (§8.1 does) — keep it when editing.
Use the new key names (sb_publishable_ / sb_secret_) in anything written; 0003 still grants to anon / service_role, which stays as the Full record.
